cli.intro: open-finder — NTFS index search over $MFT and the USN journal. Non-interactive CLI for agents and humans.

cmd.capabilities: Report domain capabilities and their availability
cmd.index: Build or update the NTFS index (`--update` applies USN changes)
cmd.search: Search the index, or use `--mode walk` for an explicit non-index scan
cmd.install: Install or upgrade the desktop shortcut and configuration (idempotent)
cmd.uninstall: Remove the shortcut, configuration and install marker
cmd.gui: Open the VMZ GUI window and pump host events until it closes
cmd.audit: Read audit records for the current actor
cmd.version: Print the native addon version and index directory

opt.actor: Audit actor id (user or agent name)
opt.actor-source: Audit actor source (cli, skill, plugin, gui, ...)
opt.index-dir: Index directory (defaults to the user config directory)
opt.record-limit: Cap how many MFT records a partial build scans
opt.update: Apply USN journal changes instead of rebuilding from $MFT
opt.max-records: Maximum USN records to apply in one update
opt.dry-run: Plan only, do not write an index or touch host state
opt.pattern: Glob pattern with `*` and `?`, or a regex with `--regex`
opt.match-path: Match the pattern against the full path instead of the file name
opt.path-filter: Case-insensitive substring filter on the full path
opt.modified-after-ms: Modified at or after this Unix millisecond timestamp
opt.modified-before-ms: Modified at or before this Unix millisecond timestamp
opt.limit: Maximum number of results or audit records
opt.mode: Query mode: `index`, or `walk` for the explicit non-index scan
opt.reset-config: Rewrite configuration instead of reusing it
opt.content-dir: Directory containing the staged GUI build
opt.kind: Filter audit records by actor kind
opt.id: Filter audit records by actor id
opt.capability: Filter audit records by capability id
opt.from-ms: Filter audit records from this Unix timestamp in milliseconds
opt.to-ms: Filter audit records up to this Unix timestamp in milliseconds
